name: Droost Help
description: Teaches humans and AI agents how to fully utilize Droost: a served guideline topic (the complete tool surface and the dev loop) plus an in-app help page. Enable it wherever agents drive Droost.
project_description: Droost Help teaches humans and AI agents how to use the whole Droost surface (about 60 MCP tools across 13 modules) rather than the obvious few. It ships one on-demand guideline topic, `using-droost-fully` (guidelines/topics/using-droost-fully.md), which the base module's GuidelineProvider discovers and the `droost_guidelines` MCP tool serves to agents; the topic is also listed in the AGENTS.md block that `drush droost:install` writes, so a cold agent is oriented automatically. It also implements hook_help (via an OOP `#[Hook]` class, DroostHelpHooks) to render an in-app help page at /admin/help/droost_help that maps the surface, points at the opt-in submodules, and lists the setup steps (build the brain, index the code, wire the editor). It provides no routes, permissions, config or services beyond the autowired hook class, and depends only on droost. The droost_cms recipe enables it by default. Local development only.
